comment: Documented (jsntrs-qr9): R13 -- `[]` (keep-array) and `[expr]` (the array constructor, S11) are different operators. `a[0][]` selects nothing (R11), and the constructor still "contain[s] the results of the expression within those brackets within a new array", which here has no members. An implementation that routes one through the other gets exactly one of the two right.
